_about: Public-domain Milton Palmer Braman (1799-1882), Congregational minister of Danvers, Massachusetts, for the Word Hoard: Obstacles to the Success of the Gospel (1840), his 1845 election sermon before Governor Briggs, and The Mexican War, a fast-day discourse (1847). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 112 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

braman-obstacles: Obstacles to the success of the gospel : a sermon preached at the dedication of the new meeting-house, erected by the First Religious Society in North Danvers, November 21st, 1839 (Salem, Mass. : Ives & Jewett, 1840)
braman-election-1845: A discourse delivered before His Excellency George N. Briggs, governor, His Honor John Reed, lieutenant governor, the honorable Council, and the legislature of Massachusetts, on the annual election, January 1, 1845 (Boston : Dutton and Wentworth, 1845)
braman-mexican-war: The Mexican war. A discourse delivered on the annual fast, 1847 (Danvers [Mass.] Printed at the Courier office, 1847)
